premarket.market_expectations: Neutral bias prevails as global equities show strength overnight while bond yields and the dollar rise. Domestic institutional buying counters foreign outflows, and rupee stability contrasts with oil price declines. The previous close in the lower range suggests caution despite improved risk appetite abroad. Volatility remains elevated slightly, indicating persistent uncertainty in the session ahead.
